what_happened: Job 20261030-033434-3v30 had two attempts. Both stopped in planning at the $8.00 per-job cap, with $5.50 and then $5.63 left against $5.75 needed for the producer and verifier. No code was written. The scope guard then paused line 3v30. A separate job (0n3b) raised job_usd to $12.00, which leaves $9.50 after the $2.50 spent so far. The the person running Athena measured this and lifted the pause by hand. The measurement also showed that plan size grew from 8 to 15 because of the critic's round, not because the request grew.
cause: Nothing compares the remaining job budget with the combined producer and verifier caps before a retry or after planning. Planning spend and critic rounds are not bounded against the cap, so a plan can grow and use up the budget it needs to run. The scope guard also counts these budget-stopped attempts as progress-less spend on the line and pauses it. It does not tell a cap shortfall from real scope growth. The the person running Athena therefore had to measure the spend and lift the pause by hand.
prevention: Add a check at admission, before each retry and after each planning round. It compares the job's remaining budget with the producer cap plus the verifier cap. If the budget is short, it holds the job with a clear "budget below stage caps" reason and does not run another planning attempt. The scope guard should also treat a stop caused by the budget cap as an environment stop and not count it as line spend. That way it does not pause the line, and no one has to lift the pause by hand.
proposed_request: Make Athena check a job's remaining budget against the combined producer and verifier caps. Run the check at admission, before every retry, and after each planning round. When the budget is below that combined cap, hold the job with the reason "budget below stage caps". Show the remaining amount and the amount needed, and do not start another planning attempt. Make the scope guard treat a stop caused by the per-job cap as a budget stop. It must not count that spend as progress-less line spend and must not pause the line. Acceptance: (1) a job with $5.63 left and $5.75 needed is held at the check with a message showing both numbers; (2) a job whose planning stops at the cap does not trigger a scope pause; (3) a job with enough budget runs as before; (4) a scope pause still triggers on real progress-less spend that was not caused by the cap. Tests must use records written by the real writers.
